data.body: Findings: likely not plain DC drift. The live trace is generated from the last 8s of live samples, median-centered, then reprocessed with sosfiltfilt display high-pass/low-pass on every 0.25s metrics update. Because filtfilt is zero-phase over a finite moving window, edge conditions change on every update; reproducing with the project filters showed the same physical samples in adjacent windows moving by roughly 15-27µV near/right side after a recent step/ramp artifact. The frontend replaces the latest snapshot trace wholesale, so that backend re-filtering appears as whole waveform sections moving up/down. Safer fix would be stateful/streaming display filtering or filtering a longer buffer and cropping away filter edge padding before plotting.
Review: Diagnostic evidence reviewed against code path and numerical reproduction. Conclusion is plausible and actionable; no implementation was performed in this task.
